configSystemExplainer: The greeting shown below is driven by the configuration system. To change the configuration properties, click the spanner icon in the navbar to pull up the Implementer Tools panel. Then, type <2>template</2> into the <4>Search configuration</4> input. This should filter the configuration properties to show only those that are relevant to this module. You can change the values of these properties and click <6>Save</6> to see the changes reflected in the UI

extensionExplainer: Here are some colored boxes. Because they are attached as extensions within a slot, an admin can change what boxes are shown using configuration. These boxes happen to be defined in this module, but they could attach to this slot even if they were in a different module

missingConsentTokenDetail: Start a claim visit first, then raise normal preauth from facility bill Claim details.
patientGetterExplainer: Try clicking the button below to fetch a patient from the backend
shrCheckingOpenVisit: Checking for an open SHR visit…
shrCloseVisitExplainer: The patient is normally asked to approve the closure with an OTP, and the visit stays open until they do.
shrCloseVisitFailedDetail: {{detail}} The records below are still loaded — use Close visit to try again.
shrCloseVisitIndeterminate: The SHR service did not say whether the visit closed. Try again.
shrClosureAwaitingOtpDetail: A code was sent to whoever gave consent. The visit stays open until it is entered.
shrClosureNotConfirmed: That code did not close the visit. Check it with the patient and try again.
shrClosureOtpSentDetail: The visit stays open until that code is entered.
shrConsentDeclinedDetail: This visit was not opened and no records were fetched.
shrConsentDeclinedWithReason: This visit was not opened. Reason given: {{reason}}
shrCrLookupFailed: Couldn't read the patient's registry number
shrExistingVisitReused: Reusing this patient’s open SHR visit
shrExistingVisitReusedDetail: They already consented at this facility, so no new OTP is needed.
shrFetchingRecords: Fetching records from the shared health record…
shrIdleDetail: Start a shared health record request to fetch this patient's national records for the current visit.
shrLoadFailedDetail: The consent token may have expired, or the SHR service is unreachable. Try again, or start a new request.
shrNeedsLocation: An SHR consent request must be scoped to a facility.
shrNeedsPatient: Open a patient chart to request their shared health record.
shrNoCategoriesConfiguredDetail: No FHIR resource types are configured for the shared health record viewer. Set shrResourceTypes in this module’s configuration.
shrNoCrNumberDetail: This patient has no Client Registry number, so their national records cannot be requested. Register them with the Client Registry first.
shrNoFurtherDetail: No further detail was shared for this record.
shrNoRecordsDetail: The SHR returned no records for this client for the requested categories. You can retry or close the visit.
shrPatientIncapableHelper: Closes the visit immediately, with no OTP sent.
shrPatientIncapableOfClosure: Patient unable to consent to closure (unconscious/deceased)
shrSyncFailedDetail: {{detail}} Use Sync now to try again.
shrVisitClosedDetail: SHR access has ended for this session.
shrVisitClosedOn: SHR access has ended for this session. Closed · {{date}}
